newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela joins two banks ahead of privatization.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela joins two banks ahead of privatization.

text.p: Venezuela's Deposits Guarantee Fund, or Fogade, on Monday announced the fusion of two state-owned banks, Andino and Popular, as a preliminary step to their privatization as a single unit.

Andino and Popular, two regional banks in western Venezuela, have a total of 60 branches, 35 billion bolivars ($71 million) of deposits and credit portfolios of 2.2 billion bolivars ($4.4 million), Fogade said in a release.
Fogade did not say what the unified bank would be called, when its privatization would take place or what the base price for its sale would be.
